description: This file defines the Education DTO class used for representing education-related data in HR reports within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for initializing with an employee number, converting to an array, and mapping fields to getters.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee education details, allowing normalization and extraction of education-related fields for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Education DTO with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the education data to an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods for data extraction.
